flaky.instructions: Would the CI failure in `item.text` likely pass if the same commit were run again with no code changes?

criteria.true: A transient cause: a network or registry error, a rate limit, a runner shutdown, a timeout on a normally fast step, or a test the log says fails intermittently
criteria.false: A deterministic cause: a wrong value, a compile or type error, a lint or format error, missing credentials, or an unmet threshold

cause.instructions: What caused the CI failure in `item.text`?

criteria.test_failure: A test failed because the code under test returned a wrong value or threw an exception
criteria.build_error: Compiling, type checking, or installing dependencies failed
criteria.lint: A formatter or linter rejected the code
criteria.timeout: A test, step, or job ran longer than its time limit
criteria.infra: The CI runner, network, credentials, or an external service failed, not the code
criteria.none: None of the listed causes fits, or the log does not show the cause
